firm_data.firm_description: Callinan & Smith LLP is a client-centered firm that utilizes business analytics and process management to provide more efficient and cost-effective service delivery. The firm handles litigation in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
notable_facts: The firm's members and employees were all trained under Craig J. Bruno.
The firm has an innovative approach to all aspects of its practice and harnesses the latest in technology.

email.subject: AI for Callinan & Smith LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

Callinan & Smith's focus on general liability and motor vehicle negligence claims across NY, NJ, and PA caught my attention, especially given your client-centered approach to litigation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes to explore how this applies to your practice?

Vasu
Lucio
